rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for hair, plants, or other things that have not been cut or tidied.

example.english: They have left their hair untrimmed for a long time.
example.traditional: 佢啲頭髮好耐冇修剪過喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 di1 tau4 faat3 hou2 noi6 mou5 sau1 zin2 gwo3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when something has been left without decorative additions rather than left physically uncut.

example.english: The table is untrimmed, so it actually looks cleaner.
example.traditional: 張枱冇加裝飾，睇落反而清爽啲。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 ci4 mou5 gaa1 zong1 sik1 tai2 lok6 faan2 ji4 cing1 song2 di1
